mapper.select:
SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirement_modules rm WHERE rm.module_id = m.id) AS requirement_count FROM project_modules m
AND m.category = #{category} AND m.enabled = 1
ORDER BY m.category ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.name ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_modules WHERE parent_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_modules (id, category, parent_id, name, description, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{id}, #{category}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE project_modules SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
